About Us

Designing Homes That Feel Like You.

Akarsh Interiors is a home interior design and execution studio. We combine thoughtful design, practical planning, transparent material choices and careful execution to create spaces you'll love living in every day.

  • AP + HYDAll of Andhra Pradesh & Hyderabad

  • 1Team, Design to Handover
Our Story

Interiors Built Around the Way You Live.

Every family uses its home differently. That's why we begin every project by listening — to how you cook, what you store, how you unwind and what makes a space feel like yours.

We then plan each room to your exact measurements, show you the design in 3D, help you choose materials with clear specifications, and carry out the work with care through to handover.

Our promise is simple: see your home in 3D first and start work only if you like it.
